0022600102.text: The Clippers visit the Lakers in a regular-season game, and neither team has played a 2026-27 game yet. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Lakers are without Adou Thiero (knee), Cameron Carr (oblique strain), and Collin Sexton (calf). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the most recent meeting was a 125-122 Lakers win in Los Angeles on February 20, 2026, with no games between them yet this season.
